deploy-bot: automated rollback triggered for rollout v2.12.0 -> reason: error-rate spike (5xx >= 2% over 5m). initiating rollback to v2.11.8 and starting traffic shift. :rotating_light:
maya: pause the global rollback. LargeEU tenant reported 500s only on their namespace and asked us to keep a canary so we can capture traces. can we stop the rest of the rollback and do a targeted mitigation?
chris: +1. plan: cancel remaining rollback steps, pin LargeEU production routes to v2.11.8, keep 7% tenant-scoped canary on v2.12.0 for full trace capture, increase sampling.
ops-oncall: rollback job 1744123456 is 25% complete. queued ops: drain hosts in eu-west-1 and shift LB weights. need explicit approval to cancel.
deploy-bot: rollback job paused; awaiting manual override. suppression requires approver.
nora: I approve targeted suppression for LargeEU. ops-oncall please run: `deployctl cancel 1744123456` and `deployctl pin --tenant largEEU --version v2.11.8 --reason "tenant debug window"` then `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant largeEU --version v2.12.0 --percent 7`.
ops-oncall: commands executed: `deployctl cancel 1744123456` -> success, `deployctl pin --tenant largeEU --version v2.11.8 --reason "tenant debug window"` -> success (audit id pin-cc7d), `deployctl tenant-canary --tenant largeEU --version v2.12.0 --percent 7` -> success. suppression window set to 2h; auto-rollback re-enable scheduled at 174412 + 7200 = 1744130656.
sara: creating incident INC-2024-4122 and assigning eng-runtime + eng-ml. KV snapshot `kv-snap-174412` taken, trace sampling bumped to 100% for tenant for 1h, logs retained 72h.
maya: please send a short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx for a subset of requests. Your traffic will remain stable while we gather traces; we will follow up within 4 hours."
chris: initial traces show increased decoder latency on a subset of hosts and KV miss spikes. running repro against canary hosts now. if we confirm model-only regression, prefer model-binary revert and quick canary instead of infra rollback.
ops-oncall: suppression recorded by nora, audit id a2f9. I'll watch the suppression window and re-enable automation if cleared at expiry.
sara: incident filed and linked; will update thread with repro status and customer comms. :white_check_mark:
